**Offer to Sell — 46,394 Units**

Good day,

I am Renata Mendez, an active crypto trader operating across major spot and derivatives markets. I am pleased to present the following offer for your consideration.

**Offer Summary**

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Asset | 46,394 units |
| Transaction Type | Sale |
| Structure | Paper trade (off-market, bilateral) |
| Settlement | To be agreed upon execution |
| Offer Validity | 48 hours from issuance |

**Terms & Conditions**

- The full quantity of **46,394 units** is offered as a single lot. Partial fills may be considered upon request, at my discretion.
- Pricing will be referenced against the prevailing market rate at the time of confirmation, with a mutually agreed spread.
- Execution and settlement mechanics to be finalized between counterparties prior to trade confirmation.
- All terms subject to standard due diligence and mutual agreement.

This is a paper-based arrangement — no on-chain settlement is implied until both parties execute a formal agreement.

**Next Steps**

Should this offer be of interest, please respond with your indication of intent, and we can proceed to price discovery and documentation.

I conduct my negotiations with discretion, precision, and respect for counterparty confidentiality. I look forward to a productive exchange.

Kind regards,
**Renata Mendez**
Crypto Trader

**Purchase Offer — Paper Trade**

**Instrument:** BTC/USD (or specify asset)
**Side:** Buy
**Quantity:** 10,820 units
**Order Type:** Market *(paper)*

---

**Rationale & Execution Notes**

I'm looking to accumulate 10,820 units on paper at current market levels. This size reflects a deliberate scaling position — not a full conviction load, but meaningful enough to test the thesis under live conditions. I'll be tracking fill quality, slippage assumptions, and timing against the tape before any real capital moves.

**Terms:**
- Execution: Paper only — no settlement required
- Pricing: Prevailing market on acceptance
- Validity: This session

Clean setup, no leverage games. If the structure holds, we size up.

— Joon Lee

**Offer: FLOP-HTLC Sale — 18,568 Units**

Greetings, counterparties.

I'm Jasper Whitlam, and I have **18,568 units of FLOP-HTLC** available for immediate transfer. This isn't a fire sale — it's a positioning move. I've held through the volatility, and now I'm rebalancing into assets that better fit my current thesis.

**What you're getting:**

- **Asset:** FLOP-HTLC — an HTLC-wrapped position with hashlock/timeout guarantees baked in. Settlement is conditional, transparent, and enforceable on-chain. No handshake deals, no counterparty guesswork.
- **Size:** 18,568 units, single lot. Clean number, no dust, no fragmentation games.
- **Structure:** I'm open to a straight swap, stablecoin settlement, or a negotiated mix — but the HTLC rail stays intact regardless of structure. That's non-negotiable, and it's for your protection as much as mine.

**Why buy from me?**

I price to clear, I communicate in plain terms, and I don't ghost. Terms are negotiable within reason; the hashlock terms are not. You bring liquidity, I bring a clean book and fast execution.

**Terms:**

- Price: open to offers, benchmarked to current market. Sharp bids get priority.
- Settlement: HTLC-mediated, standard timeout windows.
- Timeline: ready when you are — I don't sit on inventory.

If you've been watching FLOP-HTLC and waiting for size without slippage, this is your window. Serious inquiries only. Vague interest gets vague responses.

— **Jasper Whitlam**

---

**Terms**

I'm quoting a micro FLOP position settled via HTLC — 18,961 units, sized deliberately below institutional block thresholds to keep execution clean and settlement friction minimal.

- **Settlement rail:** HTLC with a 24-hour timelock, SHA-256 hashlock
- **Counterparty requirement:** Pre-image disclosure on-chain prior to expiry, no exceptions
- **Pricing:** Firm quote on acceptance, subject to a 15-minute validity window
- **Custody:** Non-custodial throughout; atomic swap mechanics apply

**Why this structure**

The micro denomination keeps the notional discreet while the HTLC wrapper removes settlement risk entirely — either the pre-image lands and the swap completes

**Trade Offer — Paper Sale**

**Offered by:** Jasper Whitlam
**Instrument:** Digital asset block
**Size:** 13,684 units
**Terms:** Paper sale — documentation and settlement on agreed terms

Clean size, single block, no tranching. I'm offering this on paper only — no spot delivery, no leverage games, just a straightforward contract with clear settlement terms.

If you're a serious counterparty, bring your structure and I'll bring the units. First come, first served — this block doesn't sit on the book for long.

— Jasper Whitlam

**Offer ID: YK-2024-1117-SWAP**

Greetings,

I am Yuki Kobayashi, proprietary crypto trader. I am pleased to present the following swap offer for your consideration.

**Transaction Type:** Paper Swap (Documentary Exchange)
**Volume:** 11,130 units

**Terms:**

- **Asset Pair:** As mutually agreed upon execution
- **Settlement:** On-paper basis — full documentation, zero on-chain footprint
- **Execution Window:** 48 hours from acceptance
- **Confirmation:** Dual-signature acknowledgment required

**Why This Offer:**

Paper swaps of this size suit counterparties seeking clean, auditable positioning without market impact. No slippage. No front-running exposure. Just a documented agreement between two desks that understand discretion.

**Conditions:**

- Counterparty verification required prior to binding
- Rate to be locked at time of mutual confirmation
- All records retained per standard compliance protocol

If the terms align with your mandate, reply with your desk confirmation and preferred settlement timeline. I will have documentation prepared within the hour.

Regards,
**Yuki Kobayashi**
